entries.title: Psalms 23:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> The LORD [is] my shepherd; I shall not want.

entries.title: Psalms 23:2
segments: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. {green...: Heb. pastures of tender grass} {still...: Heb. waters of quietness}

words.text: He maketh me to lie down
. {green...: Heb. pastures of tender grass} {still...: Heb. waters of quietness}

entries.title: Psalms 23:3
segments: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 23:4
segments: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou [art] with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

words.text: : for thou [art] with me; thy rod

entries.title: Psalms 23:5
segments: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over. {anointest: Heb. makest fat}

words.text: me in the presence of mine enemies

entries.title: Psalms 23:6
segments: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever. {for ever: Heb. to length of days}

words.text: . {for ever: Heb. to length of days}
